Duet AI Native

How personal Duets connect work across a company

Duet
Architecture

The AI Native architecture

Each employee delegates to their own Duet. Agent Loop connects the handoffs between roles.

  • Agent Loop routes events and tasks using policy.
  • Message Center gathers information. LoopLab supplies acceptance evidence.
02 / 14
Duet
Personal delegation

Personal delegation

AI Native starts when someone gives their Duet a concrete piece of work.

  • Gather sources, prepare a report or follow up.
  • Define the deliverable, the next owner and the acceptance criteria.

Duet
Personal delegation

Bob’s weekly report

The employee gives their Duet Bob’s original message and asks it to prepare the weekly report.

  • The reference carries the request and the reply destination.
  • The Owner reviews the file and selects Confirm send.
04 / 14
Duet
Personal delegation

One place to work with Duet

The same Duet can handle a report, a customer question and a research request.

  • Separate tasks run independently and return to My Duet.
  • Duet learns the employee’s role, standards and preferences.

Workflow example

A regulatory update

In this fictional scenario, a regulatory update calls for customers to see their application status.

  • Message Center keeps the source, publication time and summary.
  • Employees and Duets can search, subscribe or retrieve updates.

Workflow example

Nora’s impact research

Nora’s Duet flags the update as relevant, and she asks it to study the impact on applications.

  • Her Duet lists the affected processes and provides a report with sources and a draft user story.
  • Maya takes up the customer page and the internal report requirements.

Duet
Workflow example

Human chat and Duet topics

Nora, Maya, Alex and Sam discuss scope in group chat, while their Duets coordinate in a shared topic.

  • Maya uses Ask my Duet to delegate a message to her own Duet.
  • Duets share research, requirements and test questions in the topic.
08 / 14
Duet
Workflow example

Following up across days

When Nora asks for an update on Thursday, Duet can find what happened and what comes next.

  • Recent context supports the conversation. Dream consolidates memory.
  • Tracking records goals, progress, changes and their sources.

Duet
Workflow example

Event routing with Agent Loop

Alex’s Duet opens a pull request. Agent Loop uses policy to route the review to Sam’s Duet.

  • The PR event includes the pull request number and commit ID.
  • Sam’s Duet spots the missing export field and returns changes_requested.
10 / 14
Duet
Workflow example

A new commit for review

Alex’s Duet adds the missing export field and sends the new commit back through Sam’s review.

  • The same story and PR tie the finding to the fix.
  • Approval passes the version and criteria to LoopLab.
11 / 14
Duet
Workflow example

Browser acceptance with LoopLab

LoopLab replays a fixed test workflow in an independent browser to check two views of the same application.

  • The customer page and exported row should both show In review.
  • The run records steps and screenshots. Failures can return to Alex with evidence.

Workflow example

One report, four roles

One acceptance run supports each role’s Tracking and next decision.

  • The topic and Message Center link to the same report.
  • Maya reviews the evidence and decides when to release.

Duet
Closing the loop

Policy for repeatable handoffs

From the regulatory update to acceptance evidence, each deliverable gives the next person what they need to proceed.

  • Write stable review, revision and acceptance handoffs into policy.
  • People set goals, priorities and release commitments.
